searchText: what are use cases that currently depend on `eth_getProof` and now would leverage the `ExecutionPayloadHeader`? e.g., wallets could verify that the balance being shown has not been tampered with by the web3 API provider. or, IoT device could verify that remote has a specific NFT on their wallet, for example, access control (they could just send proof) or, Portal network can provide end-to-end proofs now instead of just execution proofs. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZHNrAXf3RDE (some use cases here)
